output.reason: This collective labour agreement (PKB) sets company payroll rules that feed into the PPh 21 computation for permanent employees. It provides that PPh 21 is borne by the employee, so there is no gross-up. It defines the wage structure and THR of one month's wage. It fixes BPJS Ketenagakerjaan contribution rates: employer-paid JKK (0.24% garment, 0.89% textile) and JKM (0.30%) enter gross income, while the employee-paid JHT (2%) and JP (1%) are deductible.
